items.t: Said the Kelly Administration broke the all-time capital investment record since the Department of Commerce was formed, with more than $2.5 billion in new capital investment in 2020 (2020).
items.q: In 2020, the Kelly Administration broke the all-time capital investment record since the Department of Commerce was formed with more than $2.5 billion in new capital investment.

items.t: Said winning the Panasonic project would have a positive ripple effect on small businesses in the region and across Kansas.

record.t: Was appointed Lieutenant Governor of Kansas in January 2021 while also serving as Secretary of the Kansas Department of Commerce.
record.q: David Toland is the 52nd Lieutenant Governor of Kansas and also serves as Secretary of the Kansas Department of Commerce. A seventh-generation Kansan, Toland was appointed Secretary of Commerce by Governor Laura Kelly in January 2019 and Lieutenant Governor in January 2021.

record.t: Reported that Kansas Department of Commerce efforts resulted in over $2.5 billion in new capital investment by businesses in Kansas in 2020, the highest in state history (2020).
record.q: Efforts across the Kansas Department of Commerce have resulted in over $2.5 billion in new capital investment by businesses in Kansas in 2020, an increase of nearly 80% over the previous year and the highest in state history.

record.t: Was confirmed by the Senate as Secretary of Commerce for the state of Kansas on April 1 in a 23–14 vote.
record.q: The Senate voted to confirm the appointment of David Toland to serve as Secretary of Commerce for the state of Kansas on Monday, April 1, in a 23 – 14 vote.

record.t: Was appointed Kansas Secretary of Commerce by Governor Laura Kelly in January 2019.
record.q: Toland was appointed Secretary of Commerce by Governor Laura Kelly in January 2019

record.t: Was sworn in as the 52nd Lieutenant Governor of Kansas at a ceremony at the Kansas Statehouse.
record.q: David Toland was sworn in as the 52 nd Lieutenant Governor of Kansas in a ceremony today at the Kansas Statehouse.

record.t: Oversaw Department of Commerce changes that rebuilt its business recruitment teams, launched the Office of Broadband Development, re-established a Community Development division and the Kansas Main Street Program, and launched a new economic development strategic planning process.
record.q: Under his leadership, the Department has rebuilt its in-state, domestic and international business recruitment teams; launched the state’s Office of Broadband Development; re-established a Community Development division and the Kansas Main Street Program; and launched the state’s first new economic development strategic planning process since 1986.

record.t: Led negotiations on behalf of Governor Kelly that ended the economic incentives "Border War" between Kansas and Missouri.
record.q: He also led negotiations on behalf of Governor Kelly that resulted in the end of the economic incentives “Border War” that existed between Kansas and Missouri for a decade.
